notes.title: v1.2.0 Game Update - Multiplayer is here!
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings, Corsairs![/h2][h3]I am thrilled to launch the second major update for Sky Cannoneer today, bringing local multiplayer to the world of Emoria![/h3]

[h2]Battle Games[/h2]
This first iteration of pvp comes in the form of local multiplayer via the new [b]Battle Games[/b]. In this mode, you and a friend can choose from all Techs, Superpowers, Forts, Boosters, and Summons, then clash with each other to see who reigns supreme!

And, while it's implemented as local multiplayer, the mode is designed to support Steam Remote Play Together for online pvp, including seamless support of multiple players on the same keyboard (whether virtually shared or on the same machine).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36210509/38991e78143e0d63793bee1741b474db52998b10.png[/img]


[h2]Input Rebinding and Gamepad support[/h2]
This update also includes the first pass at an [b]input remapping[/b] system, allowing you to customize your gameplay experience. This extends to the brand new [b]gamepad[/b] support added in this update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36210509/ca7ad52e62016d95896eba29eb75dc81f26f46b7.png[/img]


[h2]Lots More![/h2]
As usual, the update also includes balance tweaks, polish updates, and bug fixes. Check out the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1141570/discussions/0/3606765810648610587/]full patch notes[/url].

I'll be keeping an eye on pvp balance as well as making sure to fix any issues that crop, so let me know what you think of the new mode! Also, please leave a Review on the Store Page if you're enjoying the game -- it really does help. Thank you for supporting Sky Cannoneer!

To stay updated, like us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/elementgamesllc/]Facebook[/url] and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/ElementGamesDev]Twitter[/url]!

notes.title: v1.1.5 Game Update!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello Cannoneers![/h2]First of all, thanks for continuing to send feedback on Sky Cannoneer. I'm eager to improve the game and to incorporate your thoughts into each update.

[i]Quick aside: if you're enjoying the game and the updates, please [b]write a brief Review[/b] on the game's store page! Each review helps possible players know whether they would enjoy the game, and also helps me know what to improve in the future :).[/i]

[h2]v1.1.5 Update[/h2]This update focuses on a few Quality of Life improvements illustrated below, along with overall boosts to performance in dense combat, as well as a few balance tweaks and bug fixes.


[h3]Option: Show Entire Wall Grid[/h3]You can now visualize the entire wall placement grid at once, instead of it only appearing around your placement cursor. This is toggled in the Options dialog, Miscellaneous section.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36210509/2cd2d04db7305b3bf7d4556cb612265c76130305.png[/img]


[h3]Button: "Done Placing"[/h3]If you're done placing cannons or walls, you can click the button near the Phase Timer, which will move you right to the next phase as soon as your opponent is also done with their round.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36210509/aca50b4e86b5635ea245c623911ab04572ec1a6e.png[/img]


[h3]Fight Phase acceleration[/h3]And, in those rare cases where neither you nor your opponent can do anything during a Fight phase, such as when neither player has any claimed cannons to fire or powers/summons to use, the phase will automatically accelerate to speed things up and close things out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36210509/6eb5dde7b1c2637b82983f1e26560436e35c51e0.png[/img]


[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]As mentioned above, there are several other improvements in this update, so check out the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1141570/discussions/0/1867245431035214162/]full patch notes[/url].

[h3]Trading Cards[/h3]This week, I also added [b]Trading Cards[/b] to Sky Cannoneer, so you should be seeing them in your inventories soon.


As usual, let us know what you think of this update, and thank you for playing Sky Cannoneer!

To stay updated, please like us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/elementgamesllc/]Facebook[/url] and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/ElementGamesDev]Twitter[/url]!

notes.title: v1.1.0 Game Update!
notes.notes:
[h3]We are very excited to launch the first major update for Sky Cannoneer today, including two new game modes![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36210509/f8dea117f1ab23705e78c1b608daf6ccd4a4086b.gif[/img]

Each of these new modes individually makes the game harder, and enabling both of them is the toughest challenge currently available in Sky Cannoneer. Do you have what it takes to defeat the merciless enemy forces arrayed against you?

To support these new modes, there are new achievements as well as many balance changes. In addition, we've been working on quality of life improvements as well as bug fixes. More of those will continue to be implemented over the coming weeks, as well as a cool surprise or two ;).

Check out the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1141570/discussions/0/1749025246583131738/]full patch notes[/url].

Let us know what you think of the new gameplay, and leave a Review on the Store Page. Thank you for supporting Sky Cannoneer!

To stay updated, please like us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/elementgamesllc/]Facebook[/url] and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/ElementGamesDev]Twitter[/url]!
